description: Catch invented or stitched citations before an answer ships: up to 8 quote-and-link pairs (or the citations extracted from the text) checked against the live pages, each one graded verbatim, paraphrase, stitched or not found. One signed, logged report. Free signed sample: /x402/citation-check/sample. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base). Call without payment to get the requirements (isError result, 402 object in structuredContent); retry with the signed payment in _meta['x402/payment']. Result is signed by neo and logged.
name: paid_citation_check
title: Paid: check every citation in an answer (0.05 USDC)
